code='''def transform(grid):
    import copy
    out = copy.deepcopy(grid)
    p1 = next((r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v == 1)
    p2 = next((r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v == 2)
    dr = 1 if p2[0]>p1[0] else -1
    dc = 1 if p2[1]>p1[1] else -1
    endr, endc = p2[0]-dr, p2[1]-dc
    r,c=p1
    while r != endr and c != endc:
        r+=dr; c+=dc; out[r][c]=3
    while r != endr:
        r+=dr; out[r][c]=3
    while c != endc:
        c+=dc; out[r][c]=3
    return out
